text:
Ravi: Big shoutout to Zoe and Claire for putting together the new "Welcome Bundle" for hires — onboarding packets, quickstart, and a short demo video. Folks are loving it! :sparkles:

Zoe: Thanks! Claire did the heavy lifting on the demo script. Also added a short 'first-week checklist' to the repo: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/welcome-bundle

Claire: Teamwork! Marta helped review the security bits and made the KMS section way clearer.

Marta: Happy to help. Noted a small follow-up for Private deployment docs (linking to VPC network diagram).

welcome-bot: New hire packet published by Zoe and Claire. Reminder: add badge access walkthrough. :wave:

Ravi: kudos chain: I'll start—Zoe gets a "Welcome Wagon" kudos for leading the bundle.

kudos-bot: Ravi gave Zoe a "Welcome Wagon" kudos (reason: led onboarding bundle creation) :star2:

Zoe: Aww thanks! Claire, you're up next :)

Claire: Passing it to Marta for the security review (super helpful)

kudos-bot: Claire gave Marta a "Locksmith" kudos (reason: clarified KMS section) :lock:

Marta: Appreciate it. Also, cookies in the kitchen tomorrow for anyone who wants to meet the new hires :cookie:

Ravi: Love that. New hires + cookies = instant morale boost. Thanks everyone for moving fast on this. :heart:
